name: 滿版輪播背景＋左側中段標題
desc: 多張滿版圖片自動輪播當背景，文字群組固定在左側中段，底部置中有分頁圓點。
prompt: 背景為多張滿版圖片自動輪播，一次顯示一張，輪播到最後一張後回到第一張繼續；每張停留數秒後切換到下一張，文字元素固定在原位，不跟著圖片切換。畫面左側放一組文字，靠左對齊、對齊頁面內容寬度，整組在主視覺中垂直置中：大標題（可多行）約佔畫面寬的三分之一，右側大半畫面只留背景圖片。大標題上方可放小標籤，下方可放副標與一顆按鈕，沒有內容時省略，大標題的位置不變。
mobile: 仍撐滿一個畫面，高度要避免網址列伸縮造成跳動；背景改為直式裁切。文字群組仍靠左對齊、在主視覺中垂直置中，寬度改為接近整個畫面寬；結構不變。自動輪播保留。

en.name: Full-bleed slideshow with middle-left headline
en.desc: Several full-bleed images autoplay as the background slideshow, with a fixed text group on the middle-left and pagination dots at the bottom center.
en.prompt: The background is an autoplaying slideshow of several full-bleed images, showing one at a time and returning to the first image after the last one; each image stays for a few seconds before switching to the next, and the text elements stay fixed in place without changing with the images. Place a text group on the left side of the hero, left-aligned, aligned to the page content width, with the whole group vertically centered in the hero: a headline (may wrap to multiple lines) takes up about one third of the viewport width, leaving most of the right side to the background image. Optionally place a label above the headline and a subheading and one button below it; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the headline.
en.mobile: Still fills one viewport, avoiding height jumps caused by the address bar resizing; the background switches to a portrait crop. The text group stays left-aligned and vertically centered in the hero, with its width expanding to nearly the full viewport width; the structure is unchanged. The autoplaying slideshow is kept.

accessories.prompt: 在主視覺底部置中放一排輪播分頁小圓點，每個圓點對應一張背景圖片，目前顯示的那張以高亮表示。

en.prompt: Place a row of small slideshow pagination dots at the bottom center of the hero; each dot corresponds to one background image, and the current one is highlighted.
